gaps.sentence: The moon ___ round the Earth roughly every 27 days.
gaps.hint: a timeless fact about the moon
gaps.explanation: Timeless facts take the present simple: goes.

gaps.sentence: She ___ her laptop repaired twice this year already.
gaps.explanation: 'Has had it repaired twice this year' — present perfect of causative have.

gaps.sentence: I ___ you were in hospital — why did nobody tell me?
gaps.explanation: The finding out is in the past, so the past simple 'didn't know' is used.

gaps.sentence: The taxi ___ as soon as you come out of the terminal — look for a blue shirt.
gaps.hint: in progress at the future arrival moment
gaps.explanation: An action that will be in progress at a future moment takes the future continuous: will be waiting.

gaps.sentence: The soup ___ delicious, but I think it needs a little more salt.
gaps.hint: taste describing a quality is stative
gaps.explanation: When 'taste' describes a quality of something, it is a state verb: tastes.

gaps.sentence: She ___ me yesterday to say she had arrived safely.
gaps.hint: yesterday fixes a finished past action
gaps.explanation: 'Yesterday' is a finished past time, so the past simple is used: phoned.

gaps.sentence: She ___ three novels since she retired.
gaps.explanation: 'Since she retired' (up to now) — present perfect.

gaps.sentence: I ___ what the problem is, so let me explain it to the others.
gaps.hint: see meaning understand is a state
gaps.explanation: When 'see' means 'understand', it is a state verb and cannot be continuous: see.
